## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; Tech-led rally is concentrated and Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 all Technology), creating conflicting signals that justify caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +27.75% | 1M: +40.03%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing strength: FCX (1W: +11.44% | 1M: +26.83%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials modestly positive: DE (1W: +9.47% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Real Estate weak: WELL (1W: -10.44% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND; Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -9.59% | 1M: -11.29%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare soft: BMY (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND.

Top 5: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +27.75% | 1M: +40.03%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +64.12%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology), signaling concentration risk.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +27.75% | 1M: +40.03%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +64.12%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +14.11% | 1M: +14.31%) ABOVE TREND; Major divergence present (≥3 large-cap names with mixed 1W vs 1M such as INTC, TSLA, LLY) — watch for trend breaks and short-lived thrusts.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech mixed but driving the tape: AAPL (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +12.62%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +6.71%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +8.34%) CORRECTION, SHOP (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) RECOVERY — Tech is a primary source of both strength and dispersion (Tech 1W: +7.50% | 1M: +18.21%, 24 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials lag: JPM (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -3.68%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.81% | 1M: -3.06%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.11% | 1M: -3.59%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth weak and not confirming the tech-led advance (Financials 1W: -0.67% | 1M: -1.22%).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare under pressure with pockets of strength: UNH (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.17% | 1M: -1.33%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +10.66%) CORRECTION — sector 1W: -2.06% | 1M: -0.26% and mixed news risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Industrials and Materials leaders (DE (1W: +9.47% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.44% | 1M: +26.83%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to concentrated Tech names until breadth broadens; monitor INTC (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +8.34%) CORRECTION and SHOP (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) RECOVERY for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +64.12%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through vs exhaustion.  
BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +8.34%) CORRECTION, CME (1W: -11.33% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND — watch breakdown confirmation.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +18.21%) and Industrials (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +2.10%) — monitor breadth expansion.  
BEARISH: Real Estate (1W: -3.56% | 1M: -2.98%), Utilities (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -4.77%), Healthcare (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -0.26%) — watch for continued downside.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND — watch for sustained follow-through above recent highs to validate tech breadth; AAPL (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +12.62%) ABOVE TREND — watch pullback absorption as a risk gauge; GOOGL (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -6.18%) BELOW TREND — watch for further distribution as a negative market trigger.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
SHOP (+80): SHOP (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) RECOVERY — bullish repurchase news confirmed by strong 1W but 1M down shows distribution risk.  
PANW (+50): PANW (1W: +15.75% | 1M: +64.12%) ABOVE TREND — earnings-driven sentiment confirming price strength.  
BMY (+80): BMY (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND — bullish label expansion news but price is falling (divergence).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTC (-45): INTC (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +8.34%) CORRECTION — negative headlines align with 1W sell-off but 1M remains higher (divergence).  
META (-45): META (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.83%) BELOW TREND — employee/backlash headlines confirm weakness.  
UNH (-50): UNH (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +2.48%) ABOVE TREND — negative legal headlines create risk despite above-trend price (watch for revenue impact).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 all Technology). IBM (1W: +31.33% | 1M: +42.83%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +27.75% | 1M: +40.03%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +26.69% | 1M: +42.34%) ABOVE TREND are showing outsized strength. Major divergences in large caps—INTC (1W: -12.62% | 1M: +8.34%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +8.42%) CORRECTION and SHOP (1W: +11.54% | 1M: -8.35%) RECOVERY—monitor for trend breaks and news-driven distribution.
